evidence_excerpts: The amortized sampling section gives f_t(p) <- alpha s_t(p) + (1-alpha) f_t-1(pi_t-1(p)) and reports Var(f_t(p))/Var(s_t(p)) = alpha/(2-alpha).
text: Amortized sampling uses a reprojected running average to reduce sampling variance, but the smoothing factor creates a trade-off between noise reduction and temporal lag or blur.
